run_query_feature_extraction: run the query function to send a text input to the Hugging Face feature extraction model and get embeddings
create_query_function: create a query function that POSTs a payload to the Hugging Face inference API and returns JSON response
test_query_with_text: test the query function with a sample input string and verify it returns embedding data
build_feature_extraction_client: build a Python client that calls the Hugging Face feature extraction endpoint using requests.post with Bearer token auth
summarize_query_response: summarize the JSON response returned by the query function after sending text to the feature extraction pipeline
